original_project_files: Original Universe/ inside the combined release ZIP; exact-case duplicate names are retained as separate ZIP entries
release_packaging_files: The-Universe.* loaders plus START_HERE.md and manifest.json

formats.html: User-confirmed full launcher: shows the portal in a browser frame from this repository GitHub Pages. Internet required.
formats.xhtml: XHTML iframe launcher; browser support varies.
formats.mht: MHTML archive containing a launcher; browser support and remote iframe behavior vary.
formats.svg: User-confirmed full launcher using SVG foreignObject; support varies by browser.
formats.pdf: Clickable link to the GitHub Pages portal. PDF readers cannot reliably run the portal inside the document.
formats.epub: XHTML launcher attempt plus a link; ebook readers often restrict network access, frames, or scripts.
formats.xml: XHTML markup in an XML file; some viewers show XML source instead of rendering it.
formats.zip: Combined release package includes the snapshot and launchers; extract it and open The-Universe.html.
formats.webarchive: Safari WebArchive with an HTML launcher; remote resource behavior varies.
formats.maff: Mozilla Archive Format attempt; requires compatible software and may not be supported by current browsers.
formats.hta: Windows HTML Application launcher; Windows policy may block it. Only open files from a trusted source.
formats.docx: Clickable external link only; Word does not run the portal inside the document.
formats.doc: Legacy binary Word format is not produced by the dependency-free builder.
formats.pptx: Clickable external link only; regenerated and checked as a package. PowerPoint does not run the portal inside the presentation.
formats.ppt: Legacy binary PowerPoint format is not produced by the dependency-free builder.
formats.odp: Clickable external link only; presentation software does not run the portal inside the presentation.
formats.mht/mhtml: May not work: user reports both appear to do nothing.

rights_note: The upstream repository has no root license file. Existing attribution and notices are preserved. No new license or ownership claim is made; bundled third-party material may have separate rights.
self_hosted_runtime: docs/universe/; original-project hosting URLs rewritten to this repository GitHub Pages
hosting_note: Original-project TheUniverses/ayosus URLs resolve to this repository. Third-party game and service hosts may remain external.

format_test_notes..html: User confirmed this format displays the portal.
format_test_notes..svg: User confirmed this format displays the portal; browser SVG foreignObject support varies.
format_test_notes..mht: User reports opening this file appears to do nothing.
format_test_notes..mhtml: User reports opening this file appears to do nothing.
format_test_notes..pptx: Regenerated for this release; internal package structure and hyperlink target checked. Link-only.
format_test_notes..zip: Release package; extract it and open the HTML launcher. It does not auto-launch.

known_upstream_issue: The preserved catalog references thumbs/gn.png, which is absent from the upstream snapshot; this does not prevent the portal itself from loading.
